_finding.headline: Retrieval layer is the binding constraint: anchor recall 9/61 (14.8%) at skill-default n=10; q1/q4 got ZERO anchors.
_finding.sensitivity_probe: q1 re-fetched at n=30 -> 1/9 (only FlashAttention). Tripling budget adds derivatives, not lineage: it is the S2 relevance ranking, not the paper budget.
_finding.mechanism: S2 /paper/search relevance-ranks recent derivative/application papers above canonical lineage papers; seeds only land because resolve_seed_papers injects them by ID.
actionable_for_skill: seed-graph expansion: pull S2 references/citations of the seed paper (API provides the citation graph)
citation-count-aware ranking (S2 bulk search supports sort) or post-filter
era-stratified queries (search per time window to recover ancestors)
_finding.eval_implication: Downstream e2e (classify/outline/detail) from frozen fixtures measures graceful degradation under noisy inputs — fabrication pressure — not lineage correctness; coverage story is carried by this number.
_finding.correction: 2026-07-17: initial 10/61 (16.4%) overcounted by one — a short-title substring bug matched fixture 'Consistency Models' against the LCM anchor; matcher now requires length-ratio >= 0.75. Corrected: see headline.
